description_en: Call the ListTransitRouterRouteTableAssociations operation to query the forwarding associations for a route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router or for a network instance connection
description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterRouteTableAssociations接口查询企业版转发路由器路由表或网络实例连接已创建的关联转发关系
kebab_example: aliyun cbn list-transit-router-route-table-associations --max-results 50 --next-token a4150000 --transit-router-route-table-id vtb-bp1dudbh2d5na6b500000 --transit-router-attachment-id tr-attach-nls9fzkfat89340000 --transit-router-attachment-resource-id vpc-bp1h8vbrbcgohcju50000 --transit-router-attachment-resource-type VPC --status Active --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTransitRouterRouteTableAssociations

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query.

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query.

For a subsequent query, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned from the previous query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route table of the Enterprise Edition transit router
parameters.help_zh: 企业版转发路由器路由表ID
parameters.name: transit_router_route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network instance connection
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the next hop resource
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the next hop resource.

VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC).

VBR: virtual border router (VBR).

TR: transit router.

VPN: VPN connection
parameters.help_zh:
下一跳资源类型。

VPC：专有网络实例。
VBR：边界路由器实例。
TR：转发路由器实例。
VPN：VPN连接
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the association.

Active: The association is active.

Associating: The association is being created.

Dissociating: The association is being deleted
parameters.help_zh:
关联转发的状态。
Active：可用。
Associating：加载中。
Dissociating：卸载中
parameters.name: status
